Street Signal | Goldman Sachs: JD.com retail growth is expected to turn positive in 2H26 as new-business investment remains disciplined

Goldman Sachs issued a research note after a non-deal roadshow, highlighting what it sees as an inflection point for JD.com retail business and greater discipline in investment in new businesses. The bank maintained a positive rating.

Goldman Sachs expects JD.com retail revenue growth to reach an inflection point in the second half of 2026. Performance during the 618 shopping festival and a rebound in June offset weakness in April and May, and the bank expects retail revenue to return to positive year-over-year growth in the third quarter.

Losses in the food-delivery business are continuing to narrow. Management expects the third-quarter loss to decline sharply year over year.

Investment in Joybuy is being brought forward but remains controllable, at approximately RMB 2 billion per quarter.

JD.com commitment to long-term shareholder returns is unchanged. The company’s remaining approximately $1 billion share-repurchase plan is expected to be completed by August 2027.

Goldman Sachs views the developments as positive for JD.com (JD.US/9618.HK citing a clear inflection point in retail growth. However, competition in food delivery remains intense, and the Joybuy investment cycle is relatively long.

The pace of near-term earnings improvement therefore remains uncertain, and Goldman Sachs says this aspect has not yet been fully priced in by the market.

The note identifies four potential catalysts: confirmation that retail revenue returns to positive growth in the third quarter of 2026; the extent of the year-over-year reduction in food-delivery losses; progress in expanding Joybuy into new markets; and the pace of share-repurchase execution.

然而，從結構來看，有更嚴重的問題。
・商品零售收入：-5.4%（電子產品・家電 -11.8%、日用百貨 +5.6%）
・服務收入：+6.8%（平台・廣告 +8.3%、物流他 +5.9%）

商品（以自營為主）的比率依然很高，即便服務化進展，也未能支撐銷售的主軸。

此外，包含外送等新事業，
第1四半期約103.5億元、第2四半期約98.5億元的營業損失。損失雖有縮減，但仍相當沉重。

利潤雖有改善（營業利益轉為黑字），零售毛利率也上升，但這很大程度上是傳統手法，即以規模為背景強化採購壓力的側面。

市場的擔憂點，並非銷售額的暫時減少，而是京東是否正從「成長型平台」轉向「新事業失敗」以及「自營依賴的傳統零售模式」。
